name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.6.1 searches Shopify Global Catalog, reserves EXACT for strong product identity, renders evidence-rich product cards with non-blocking images and client-stage timing, queries a configured verified Deals API, and binds persistent identity-specific price, promotion, inventory, and restock Watch rules to native Codex Automation. Product Watch creation requires a generation/model/GTIN and explicit condition. Monitoring becomes active only after its Automation ID is durably bound. Without approved data or affiliate relationships it fails closed and uses canonical merchant links. User-authorized Chrome remains a bounded one-time fallback, never an automated Watch source.
defaultPrompt: Search products, find verified deals, or create and bind a Watch to Codex Automation. Never launch MCP.
